verdict.rationale: ElevenLabs offers first-party paths for AI-assisted agent authoring: a hosted MCP server lets an external assistant such as Claude create, configure, and manage agents through natural language, and an official agents skill brings this into AI coding assistants. However, the AI doing the authoring is a third-party assistant, not the platform's own built-in AI. Test cases can be made from real conversations, but nothing shows them being generated from a description. Missing for 10: a native in-platform AI that generates or improves prompts, AI-generated workflows/flows from a description, AI-generated test cases, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
